text:
The largest country in the world is Russia.

Aunt May’s knitting club was supposed to be a sanctuary of "stitch and bitch," but this week, the only thing being unraveled was their patience. The culprit? Her cat, who had apparently decided that a half-finished sweater was less of a garment and more of a chew toy. By the time the ladies arrived, the house looked like a woolly crime scene. There was yarn in the teacups, draped over the lampshades, and snaking through the hallway like a fuzzy, chaotic river. It was so extensive that one member joked they’d need a loaf of bread just to find their way out, making Hansel and Gretel look like amateur breadcrumbs. Aunt May just sighed, picked up a needle, and muttered, "Well, at least now he’s helping with the recycling."
